text: The PIF Saudi International (Nov 18-21, 2026, Riyadh Golf Club, USD 5m purse) is title-sponsored by PIF and presented/powered by SoftBank Investment Advisers; the International Series site still describes it as the Series finale whose rankings determine LIV Golf promotion spots, wording that may predate the July 2026 LIV-Asian Tour split.
short: PIF titles and SoftBank Investment Advisers presents the Saudi International, the $5m season finale.
